claims.text: Greg Short asserts that peak performance periods in growth, revenue, income, and community value correlate with 100% concentrated focus on a single domain — not a diversified portfolio of activities. Across his 12-year entrepreneurial journey, his highest-output periods consistently coincided with undivided mindshare on one thing.
claims.speaker: Greg Short
conditions: short time-horizon goals (exceptional results in a short period)

claims.text: Greg Short asserts that every person he has observed achieve exceptional results in a short period of time put 100% of their mindshare into a single endeavor, not a diverse portfolio. This pattern held across all individuals he encountered in 12 years of his entrepreneurial journey.
claims.speaker: Greg Short
conditions: exceptional results sought in a compressed time period
bounded_by: Speaker does not address whether diversification is viable over multi-decade horizons

practices.text: Remove the noise and maintain 100% focus on a single domain rather than spreading mindshare across a diverse portfolio of activities.
